title: One line of a catalog's capture identity tool's output
description: One capture the identity tool found beneath the attachment directory it was given (engine API 0.2.1). Every field is present; a value the capture does not state is null and the reason is in problems.

capture.description: The capture's root or report directory, relative to the artifact root.

target.description: The cluster ID or host name, null when it cannot be read.

time.description: The capture time with its offset, where the capture states one.

local_time.description: The capture time without a zone, where the capture states none.

raw_time.description: The capture time as the capture states it.

problems.description: Short reasons a field could not be read or is in doubt.
